overview: Replaces the game's recipe book with one that searches properly and crafts the intermediate parts for you, so a thing you want is a click rather than a dig through lists.

1.2.3: Where one result has several recipes, arrows by the title step through them.
The book opens on a recipe you can make now.
A plan no longer spends what it is making.
The catalog leaves out recipes a mod deliberately hides.
1.2.0: The whole catalog, not only what you have unlocked.
Plans know how many you asked for.
A recipe you click is one the server teaches you on the spot.
1.1.0: The replacement book: craftable shown in colour and picture, not in a tooltip.
A craftable-only toggle under the page arrows, on by default.
Another station's recipes stay out of the workbench's list.
The book opens at somebody else's bench too.
